gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histologically confirmed glioblastoma as defined by the World Health Organization (WHO) 2021 Criteria (IDH-wildtype) that is either methylated, unmethylated, or indeterminate MGMT.

candidate_evidence.quote: the investigational drug ruxolitinib when it is combined with standard of care treatment (radiation therapy and temozolomide)

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Ruxolitinib With Radiation and Temozolomide Compared to Radiation and Temozolomide for Newly Diagnosed Glioblastoma

role_evidence.quote: Half the people in the study will be assigned to take the study drug ruxolitinib in addition to the standard of care temozolomide and radiation therapy

[ACTIVE_COMPARATOR] Radiation and Temozolomide: There will be two phases of drug administration: (1) Temozolomide will be administered "During Radiation Therapy" and (2) Maintenance phase after radiation therapy is complete.
